# 0.9.0-alpha01

> **Alpha, checked on an emulator only.** Unit tests pass on both flavours and the new screens were looked at on an emulator. Nothing here has been on a real phone yet, so playback, casting, downloads, notifications and widgets are unverified on a device. Expect bugs and report them on GitHub.
>
> Version `0.9.0-alpha01` (`1900001`). Installs as **Editotsu α** (`ani.editotsu.beta`) and updates alpha02 in place.

- **New Features:**
  - Picking a source looks like the rest of the app
    - The source row on a show is one card with the extension's icon and name; tapping it opens a sheet with every source
    - The source you picked is remembered by name, so installing or removing an extension no longer moves you to a different one
    - Language is a card under it that opens the same kind of sheet. Extensions whose sources share one language list them by name instead of showing the same language several times
  - Extensions screen and extension settings redrawn
    - Extensions are settings-style rows with a proper header and back button
    - An extension's own settings use the same rows, sheets and text fields as Settings
    - Repositories are managed in a sheet; a repository's links (project page, website, Discord, copy link) sit behind one button so its address is readable
  - Settings use the control that fits the value: steppers for counts, sliders for ranges, segmented buttons for two or three options, one sheet for every pick-one list
  - Comments
    - Comment rows redrawn: smaller avatar, name, level and age on one line, icon buttons for votes, reply and edit
    - Comments are off until you turn them on, and your AniList token is not sent to the comment server before that
  - Loading looks like the content that is coming
    - Episode lists, the info page, home rows, lists, comments, the feed and notifications show placeholder shapes with a moving highlight instead of a spinner
    - A source that has nothing for a show says so instead of loading forever
  - Watch order sheet rebuilt, with readable relation names
  - Episode previews without black bars, and previews for shows that had none
  - Long episode titles expand when tapped
  - Shows open faster on sources that need a title search
  - Upscaler defaults to Off; models are listed light to heavy with what each costs
  - Tracker progress that fails to send is queued and retried when you are back online
  - Cast: the next episode plays on the TV and subtitles reach the receiver
  - About shows a fixed credits list and no longer contacts a git host to build it

- **Bugfixes:**
  - "Cannot find any installed extensions" appeared on shows even with extensions installed
  - Pull-to-refresh spinners were white on white; they use the theme colour now
  - Dragging an extension to reorder it pulled the refresh instead of moving the row
  - Menus opened from a three-dot button were flat squares; they are rounded with a shadow
  - The home header showed "null" for your stats until they loaded
  - Tapping the source card twice could open two sheets
  - Picking another source could snap back to the old one and leave the episode list empty
  - The main studio was missing from the info page
  - The home search button was white on a white background in light themes
  - Debug and alpha builds showed the beta splash and logo
  - Failed AniList posts (activity, reply, message, forum) looked like they had gone through; the editor now stays open with an error
  - An expired AniList login is reported as such
  - Opening a backup from another app overwrote data without asking
  - App lock dropped you on the home screen instead of what you opened; the stats widget skipped the lock
  - Offline mode did not return to the online app when the network came back
  - An empty calendar week stayed empty until the cache expired
  - Download queues could stall, cancelled downloads left files behind, and a failed folder move lost the old folder
  - Starting a torrent download removed the torrent that was playing
  - Reader: very large pages could run out of memory, AVIF and JXL pages from extensions failed to decode, the next chapter differed by reading direction
  - Player: audio track is kept per show, stale skip times, sleep timer state, picture-in-picture and lock fixes
  - Notifications in alarm mode and subscription checks
  - Each extension update gets its own notification
  - The updater ranks rc versions correctly
  - Account tokens are kept out of Android backups; the AniList login callback is accepted only for a login started in the app

- **Known issues:**
  - A torrent you haven't played before can still take 5 to 30 seconds to start on a slow swarm, and long seeks are slow
  - The scanlator field on the manga page still uses the old outlined style
  - The episode options dialog, the comments header (sort, episode filter, rules) and the profile, activity and offline pages have not been redesigned yet
  - The Themes tab, the trending banner and the GIF picker still load with a spinner
  - AnimeThemes can take up to a minute the first time you open a show
  - The Android TV launcher banner is still Dantotsu's
  - The Degoogle'd build has no in-app updater

- **Which apk?**
  - `Editotsu-0.9.0-alpha01-google-arm64-v8a.apk`: most modern phones
  - `Editotsu-0.9.0-alpha01-google-universal.apk`: other architectures
  - `Editotsu-0.9.0-alpha01-fdroid-arm64-v8a.apk`: Degoogle'd, most modern phones
  - `Editotsu-0.9.0-alpha01-fdroid-universal.apk`: Degoogle'd, other architectures
